Plans change.

How to move a booking, how to cancel one, and what happens to anything you've paid.

Ask us anything We'll call you back, and send a confirmation by email.

Draft

A working draft. The notice periods and refund percentages below are placeholders — set the ones you can actually honour, then have this reviewed before launch. Whatever you publish here is what customers will hold you to.

Last updated: 7 October 2026

If you only pre-booked

If you chose to pay after we call, there's nothing to cancel — tell us, or just let us know when we ring, and you owe nothing. If you've already paid by UPI, the rules below apply, and if we can't give you the slot you asked for, you get every rupee back.

Moving a confirmed booking

  • More than 48 hours before your slot: we'll move you to any free slot at no charge.
  • 24 to 48 hours before: we'll move you once if a slot is free.
  • Less than 24 hours before: we'll try, but we can't promise — the slot may already be held for you and turned away from others.

Ask as early as you can. The earlier you tell us, the more we can do.

Cancelling a confirmed booking

  • More than 48 hours before your slot: full refund of anything paid.
  • 24 to 48 hours before: 50% refund.
  • Less than 24 hours before, or not turning up: no refund.

Where decor, cake, flowers or a photographer have already been arranged for you, we may have to deduct what we've already spent. We'll tell you the amount and why.

If we cancel

If we have to cancel or move your session for any reason, you get the choice of the next available slot or a full refund of everything you've paid. No deductions.

Arriving late

Your session ends at its scheduled time regardless of when you arrive, because another booking may follow yours. If the room is free afterwards we'll do what we can. No refund is due for time you didn't use.

How refunds are paid

Back to the same method you paid with, wherever possible.

Something went wrong on the night

Tell us while you're still there if you can — most things we can fix on the spot. If we couldn't give you what you booked, say so and we'll put it right.

Get in touch

To move or cancel a booking, contact us or call us directly. Please have your booking date and the name it was made under.
